name: Custom Service Plastics, Inc. Corporate Headquarters
old_description: Custom Service Plastics, LLC (CSP) operates out of facilities totaling over 200,000 sq. ft located in beautiful Lake Geneva, Wisconsin. CSP has been in operation since 2000 supporting a large host of Fortune 500 company’s worldwide operations.
about:
Custom Service Plastics, LLC (CSP) has operated from Lake Geneva, Wisconsin since 2000. The company occupies facilities totaling more than 200,000 square feet at 201 Sheridan Springs Road and is certified as a Woman Business Enterprise (WBE), a Minority Business Enterprise (MBE), and an SBA-designated Small Disadvantaged Business operating under the IATF 16949 quality management system.

CSP provides custom plastic molding and complete engineering solutions, supported by a team of engineering, quality, and manufacturing associates. The operation emphasizes cost efficiency and on-time delivery across its production floor, offering low-cost engineering support for diverse client needs.

The molder serves Fortune 500 companies worldwide, delivering components for global supply chains across multiple industries.

Founded on a commitment to be a leader in custom molding partnerships, CSP focuses on timely, cost-effective solutions that add value within the customer-supplier relationship. The company states its reputation speaks for itself, built on capturing the minute details of each customer's requirements.
